waveform_window.Vpp_definition: max(real summed carrier waveform)-min over the finite stated samples; sub-sample extrema are not solved
waveform_window.modulation_definition: 2min(abs(delta_phi_2000),abs(delta_phi_2010)); envelope depth, not a physical 10Hz voltage spectral component
waveform_window.spectrum_definition: Coherent real-waveform DFT, peak phasor 2*FFT/N at2000/2010Hz; remaining-bin maximum retained

provenance.configuration_identity_definition: SHA256 of canonical JSON identity tuple; this is not a fabricated per-case configuration file
provenance.contact_version_if_absent: No separate version declared; use receipt SHA/schema
provenance.material_version_if_absent: No separate version declared; use receipt SHA/schema
provenance.raw_export_source_label: Source that exported stored response; reused old carrier PDE is not counted as a new solve
